title: North Korea Choe Hyun-class warship construction observed via satellite
snippet: UPI April 2, 2026 — Satellite imagery reveals construction of a Choe Hyun-class warship at a North Korean naval shipyard. Imagery shows hull assembly and fitting activity at Nampho/west coast shipyard. Part of DPRK naval modernization program.
tag_reason: New event; satellite-observed naval construction activity in North Korea.
